Basilewsky (1979) later reported this species as a Tachyphanes from Asir Province. El-Hawagry et al. (2013) recently listed this species as Elaphropus variabilis from Baha Province. Sciaky & Vigna-Taglianti (2003) treats the species as a Sphaerotachys.
